title: Test 4 – Miêu tả Người (Xáo trộn ngẫu nhiên & Câu hỏi mới)

exercises.instruction: Mô tả phần trang phục phía dưới.

options.text: She is trying on a pair of pants.
She is wearing a flowing skirt.
The dress is hanging on a rack.
She is tying her shoelaces.

exercises.explanation: 'Flowing skirt' là một chiếc váy dài xòe bay bổng.

exercises.instruction: Mô tả nào khớp với bức ảnh?

options.text: The glass is completely empty.
She is serving beverages to guests.
She is consuming a liquid from a container.
She is breaking a cup.

exercises.explanation: 'Consuming a liquid from a container' là cách nói gián tiếp cho việc đang uống (drinking).

exercises.instruction: Hành động nào đang diễn ra trên cầu thang?

options.text: People are climbing up to the top floor.
Individuals are making their way down the steps.
Someone is sweeping the staircase.
They are waiting at the bottom of the stairs.

exercises.explanation: 'Making their way down the steps' có nghĩa là đi xuống các bậc thang.

exercises.instruction: Điền từ miêu tả hành động bảo vệ đầu.
exercises.content: He is wearing a safety ________ on a construction site.
exercises.explanation: 'Safety helmet' (mũ bảo hộ) là vật dụng thiết yếu ở công trường.

exercises.instruction: Người đàn ông đang mang vật nặng như thế nào?

options.text: He is dragging a box on the floor.
He is holding a heavy item on his shoulders.
He is dropping a sack.
He is opening a parcel.

exercises.explanation: Mang vác trên vai hay đầu đều có thể miêu tả bằng 'holding a heavy item on his shoulders/head'.

exercises.instruction: Chọn mô tả đúng về phụ kiện ở mặt.

options.text: He is putting on his sunglasses.
He is wearing corrective eyewear.
He is taking off his spectacles.
His glasses are resting on the table.

exercises.explanation: 'Corrective eyewear' là cách nói trang trọng để chỉ kính cận/kính thuốc.

exercises.instruction: Mô tả nào đúng cho nhóm người?

options.text: They are occupying seats around the table.
They are unfolding the chairs.
They are standing in a circle.
They are purchasing furniture.

exercises.explanation: 'Occupying seats' (đang ngồi vào ghế) là cách nói đồng nghĩa với sitting.

exercises.instruction: Mô tả công việc dọn dẹp.

options.text: The floor is being washed with a mop.
A broom is being used to clear dirt from the floor.
The dustpan is full of trash.
The person is dusting the shelves.

exercises.explanation: 'A broom is being used' (Chổi đang được sử dụng để quét sạch bụi).

exercises.instruction: Điền V-ing để miêu tả sự soi gương.
exercises.content: He is ________ his own reflection.
exercises.explanation: 'Examining his own reflection' là đang soi gương cẩn thận.

exercises.instruction: Đâu là câu miêu tả trang phục chính xác?

options.text: He is putting on his uniform.
He is dressed in formal business clothing.
The suit is hanging in the closet.
He is wearing a casual t-shirt.

exercises.explanation: 'Dressed in formal business clothing' là cách diễn đạt đúng cho việc mặc áo vest.

exercises.instruction: Mô tả nào đúng với hành động ở màn hình?

options.text: He is repairing the computer.
He is cleaning the monitor screen.
He is focusing his attention on the display.
He is moving the monitor aside.

exercises.explanation: 'Focusing his attention on the display' diễn đạt việc đang nhìn chằm chằm vào màn hình.

exercises.instruction: Điền từ chỉ đồ vật đang được cầm.
exercises.content: The individual is grasping a ________ to sign the document.
exercises.explanation: Đồ vật dùng để ký tên (sign) là cây bút (pen).

exercises.instruction: Điền từ chỉ hành động tác dụng lực.
exercises.content: A heavy cart is being ________ forward.
exercises.explanation: Xe đẩy được đẩy về phía trước (being pushed forward).

exercises.instruction: Điền từ cảnh báo.
exercises.content: An ________ message is displayed on the monitor.
exercises.explanation: Thông báo lỗi tiếng Anh là 'error message'.

exercises.instruction: Điền danh từ chỉ trang phục bên ngoài.
exercises.content: The worker is visible in a high-visibility ________.
exercises.explanation: 'High-visibility vest' là loại áo khoác bảo hộ phản quang.

exercises.instruction: Điền từ liên quan đến máy tính.
exercises.content: She is actively using the computer ________.
exercises.explanation: Hành động gõ phím liên quan mật thiết tới 'keyboard'.

exercises.instruction: Họ đang làm gì?

options.text: They are greeting each other with a handshake.
They are waving hello from a distance.
They are clapping for a performance.
They are handing out flyers.

exercises.explanation: 'Greeting each other with a handshake' (chào nhau bằng cái bắt tay).

exercises.instruction: Điền từ chỉ cử chỉ tay.
exercises.content: He is indicating a chart by ________ at it.
exercises.explanation: 'Pointing at' (chỉ tay vào) dùng để nhấn mạnh chi tiết (indicating).

exercises.instruction: Điền từ để hoàn thành câu.
exercises.content: A heavy ________ is strapped to his shoulders.
exercises.explanation: 'Strapped to his shoulders' (buộc/đeo trên vai) mô tả cái balo (backpack).

exercises.instruction: Mô tả hành động của người này.

options.text: A person is hanging up the telephone.
Someone is engaged in a mobile conversation.
The phone has been left on the desk.
She is putting the phone in her pocket.

exercises.explanation: 'Engaged in a mobile conversation' tương đương với việc nói chuyện qua điện thoại di động.

exercises.instruction: Điền từ mô tả hành động ghi chép.
exercises.content: The instructor is ________ some notes on the whiteboard.
exercises.explanation: 'Jotting down' hoặc 'writing' notes nghĩa là ghi chép nhanh lên bảng.

exercises.instruction: Điền phụ kiện đi kèm sơ mi.
exercises.content: He has a neck________ fastened around his collar.
exercises.explanation: Cà vạt có thể gọi là 'necktie'.

exercises.instruction: Điền từ miêu tả hành động với sách.
exercises.content: She is absorbed in ________ a publication.
exercises.explanation: 'Absorbed in reading' (say sưa đọc sách).

exercises.instruction: Điền danh từ chỉ trang phục.
exercises.content: He has chosen to wear a patterned ________ today.
exercises.explanation: Áo sơ mi có họa tiết được miêu tả là 'patterned shirt'.

exercises.instruction: Điền động từ ở thì hiện tại tiếp diễn.
exercises.content: A person is ________ upright near the desk.
exercises.explanation: 'Standing upright' (đứng thẳng).

exercises.instruction: Phụ kiện đi kèm.

options.text: A purse is being carried over her shoulder.
She left her bag on the chair.
She is searching inside her handbag.
She is purchasing a new tote bag.

exercises.explanation: Carried over her shoulder (đeo trên vai).

exercises.instruction: Điền trạng thái vắt chéo.
exercises.content: The seated woman has her legs ________.
exercises.explanation: Legs crossed (chân vắt chéo).

exercises.instruction: Điền từ chỉ vị trí cạnh bên.
exercises.content: She is seated ________ to the glass pane.
exercises.explanation: 'next to' (bên cạnh).

exercises.instruction: Tư thế tựa.

options.text: He is painting the wall.
The wall is being repaired.
A person is resting their weight against a flat surface.
He is pushing the wall hard.

exercises.explanation: Resting their weight against (Tựa sức nặng vào bề mặt).

exercises.instruction: Sử dụng phân từ để rút gọn.
exercises.content: ________ a briefcase, the man stands formally.
exercises.explanation: Dùng V-ing 'Holding' đứng đầu câu để miêu tả hành động cầm túi.

exercises.instruction: Câu kết hợp nào hợp lý nhất?

options.text: He is drinking coffee while looking down at a device.
He is staring at the sky and drinking tea.
He is throwing a cup and holding a phone.
He is taking a photo of his coffee.

exercises.explanation: 'while looking down at a device' (trong khi nhìn xuống thiết bị).

exercises.instruction: Mô tả lực nâng.

options.text: He is dropping the heavy package.
A box is being hoisted from the floor.
He is dragging a carton.
He is taping the box shut.

exercises.explanation: 'A box is being hoisted' dùng bị động thay thế cho lifting.

exercises.instruction: Điền V-ed chỉ việc mặc đồ.
exercises.content: The professionals are ________ sharply in business suits.
exercises.explanation: 'Dressed sharply' là cách khen ngợi ăn mặc bảnh bao, lịch sự.

exercises.instruction: Tình trạng của chiếc áo.

options.text: The shirt is unbuttoned at the top.
His collar is completely buttoned up.
He is ironing his shirt.
He is rolling up his sleeves.

exercises.explanation: Buttoned up (được cài cúc kín).

exercises.instruction: Điền đồ vật đeo tay.
exercises.content: A wrist________ is strapped to his arm.
exercises.explanation: Wristwatch (đồng hồ đeo tay).

exercises.instruction: Điền giới từ.
exercises.content: The scene is viewed ________ the clear glass of the window.
exercises.explanation: Viewed through (được nhìn xuyên qua).

exercises.instruction: Câu nào sử dụng sự tương phản đúng?

options.text: One person is seated, while another is on their feet.
Everyone in the room is seated.
One person stands before sitting down.
They are walking in opposite directions.

exercises.explanation: 'While another is on their feet' là cụm từ khác của standing.

exercises.instruction: Điền từ phân biệt bên phải.
exercises.content: A sheet of paper is held in his ________ hand.
exercises.explanation: Phân biệt right hand và left hand.

exercises.instruction: Hành động sắp sửa xảy ra.

options.text: They have just finished crossing the road.
They are on the verge of stepping into the street.
They are sitting on the pavement.
A car is blocking their path.

exercises.explanation: On the verge of stepping (sắp sửa bước xuống phố).

exercises.instruction: Điền từ chỉ vị trí quanh bàn.
exercises.content: Colleagues are positioned ________ a circular desk.
exercises.explanation: 'Positioned around' (được bố trí/ngồi xung quanh).

exercises.instruction: Điền V-ing hành động xỏ áo.
exercises.content: He is currently ________ on an article of clothing.
exercises.explanation: Putting on an article of clothing (mặc một món đồ vào người).

exercises.instruction: Đâu là câu miêu tả bằng cụm giới từ?

options.text: The woman wears a red dress standing.
The lady in the red dress is speaking.
She puts on a red dress.
A red dress is wearing the woman.

exercises.explanation: 'The lady in the red dress' là cụm danh từ rút gọn cực kỳ tự nhiên.

exercises.instruction: Cuộc đối thoại hai người.

options.text: They are arguing aggressively.
An exchange of words is taking place between them.
They are ignoring each other.
One person is whispering a secret.

exercises.explanation: An exchange of words (sự trao đổi lời nói) bằng với cuộc hội thoại.

exercises.instruction: Mô tả cánh tay.

options.text: He is pointing at someone.
His arms are securely interlocked in front of him.
He is raising his hands up.
He is holding a thick book.

exercises.explanation: Arms securely interlocked (Hai tay khóa chặt/khoanh lại trước mặt).

exercises.instruction: Điền trạng từ chỉ hướng ra xa.
exercises.content: She has shifted her focus ________ from the screen.
exercises.explanation: 'Shifted focus away' (đổi sự tập trung ra chỗ khác).

exercises.instruction: Mô tả một người trong nhóm.

options.text: Every woman is frowning.
A single woman out of the group is grinning.
None of the women are smiling.
All of them are laughing out loud.

exercises.explanation: 'A single woman out of the group' là một cách nói dài của 'One of the women'.

exercises.instruction: Điền lượng từ chỉ cả hai.
exercises.content: ________ figures in the image are wearing neckties.
exercises.explanation: Dùng 'Both' cho hai người.

exercises.instruction: Điền giới từ.
exercises.content: The individual ________ a tailored suit looks professional.
exercises.explanation: Dùng 'in' trước trang phục để thay cho wearing.

exercises.instruction: Điền từ miêu tả hành động cúi.
exercises.content: The individual is ________ down to grab a package.
exercises.explanation: Bending down (cúi người xuống).

exercises.instruction: Mô tả trạng thái làm việc.

options.text: The laptop has been shut down.
He is busy operating his portable computer.
He is unplugging the charger.
He is taking a break from his tasks.

exercises.explanation: Operating his portable computer (sử dụng máy tính xách tay).

exercises.instruction: Mô tả hành động đi bộ thư giãn.

options.text: They are jogging rapidly down the trail.
They are taking a relaxed walk through the greenery.
They are riding bicycles.
They are resting on the grass.

exercises.explanation: Taking a relaxed walk (đi bộ thư giãn) = strolling.

exercises.instruction: Điền từ chỉ môi trường làm việc.
exercises.content: A professional is dressed in clinical or ________ attire.
exercises.explanation: Clinical or laboratory attire (trang phục phòng khám hoặc phòng thí nghiệm).

exercises.instruction: Mô tả hai người đối mặt.

options.text: They are sitting shoulder to shoulder.
They are seated directly opposite one another.
One person is standing behind the other.
They are looking in opposite directions.

exercises.explanation: Directly opposite one another (trực tiếp đối diện nhau).

exercises.instruction: Điền từ cho trang phục cao cấp.
exercises.content: He is donning highly sophisticated ________.
exercises.explanation: Sophisticated attire (trang phục tinh tế, trang trọng).

exercises.instruction: Điền động từ chỉ sự hoan hô.
exercises.content: The crowd is enthusiastically ________.
exercises.explanation: Enthusiastically applauding (Vỗ tay nhiệt liệt).

exercises.instruction: Tư thế khuỵu gối.

options.text: The individual is lying flat on their stomach.
The individual is resting on bent knees.
The person is standing on tiptoes.
The person is leaping in the air.

exercises.explanation: Resting on bent knees (Tựa lên đầu gối uốn cong) = kneeling.

exercises.instruction: Điền từ miêu tả đám đông.
exercises.content: A large ________ has clustered around the focal point.
exercises.explanation: A large crowd / group has clustered (Một nhóm đông đã tụ lại).

exercises.instruction: Di chuyển song song.

options.text: They are moving forward in tandem.
One is lagging far behind the other.
They are stepping on each other's feet.
They are running a race.

exercises.explanation: Moving forward in tandem (Tiến về phía trước song hành cùng nhau).

exercises.instruction: Trang phục dạo phố.

options.text: She is wearing a formal evening gown.
She is sporting everyday, relaxed clothing.
She is dressed for a winter storm.
She is wearing a protective suit.

exercises.explanation: Everyday, relaxed clothing (Quần áo thư giãn, thường ngày).

exercises.instruction: Điền từ miêu tả hành khách.
exercises.content: The daily ________ are traveling to the city center.
exercises.explanation: Commuters (những người đi làm xa bằng xe công cộng).

exercises.instruction: Mô tả chồng hàng hóa.

options.text: The items are scattered randomly.
Boxes are piled one on top of the other.
The packages are being opened.
The shelves are completely bare.

exercises.explanation: Piled one on top of the other (Xếp chồng cái nọ lên cái kia).

exercises.instruction: Điền động từ thể hiện việc dùng tay để diễn tả.
exercises.content: He is ________ wildly to make his point clear.
exercises.explanation: Gesturing wildly (Múa tay mạnh mẽ).

exercises.instruction: Mô tả việc cân chỉnh kính.

options.text: He is cleaning the lenses with a cloth.
He is repositioning his glasses on his nose.
He is taking off his helmet.
He is covering his eyes.

exercises.explanation: Repositioning (chỉnh lại vị trí) = adjusting.

exercises.instruction: Phát biểu trước công chúng.

options.text: The speaker is writing on a whiteboard.
Remarks are being directed to an assembled group.
The audience is ignoring the speaker.
The microphone is turned off.

exercises.explanation: Remarks are being directed to an assembled group (Những lời phát biểu đang được nhắm tới nhóm người tụ họp).

exercises.instruction: Điền giới từ.
exercises.content: The customer is leaning ________ the service desk.
exercises.explanation: Leaning over/across (Nhoài người qua).

exercises.instruction: Khách hàng trong cửa tiệm.

options.text: Shoppers are casually inspecting retail items.
The cashier is scanning barcodes.
Products are being stocked on empty shelves.
The store is currently closed.

exercises.explanation: Inspecting retail items (Kiểm tra/xem xét các mặt hàng bán lẻ) = browsing.

exercises.instruction: Hàng người đang xếp.

options.text: People are lined up sequentially.
The queue has dispersed.
Everyone is rushing to the front.
They are wandering aimlessly.

exercises.explanation: Lined up sequentially (xếp hàng theo thứ tự).

exercises.instruction: Mô tả sự kiểm tra tỉ mỉ.

options.text: The blueprint is being thoroughly scrutinized.
He is rolling up a poster.
The document is being printed out.
He is tearing up the paper.

exercises.explanation: Thoroughly scrutinized (được xem xét kỹ lưỡng) là cấu trúc bị động mức độ Hard.

exercises.instruction: Điền danh từ cho cuộc đối thoại nghiêm túc.
exercises.content: The men are locked in a deep ________.
exercises.explanation: Locked in a deep conversation (đang mải mê đàm thoại sâu).

exercises.instruction: Điền động từ chỉ việc nắm lấy.
exercises.content: An arm is outstretched to ________ the object.
exercises.explanation: Outstretched to grasp (vươn ra để nắm lấy).

exercises.instruction: Điền từ mô tả phía sau.
exercises.content: We can only see the ________ of his head.
exercises.explanation: The back of his head (phía sau đầu).

exercises.instruction: Điền từ chỉ việc đưa đồ vật.
exercises.content: An object is being ________ to the recipient.
exercises.explanation: Being handed (được trao tay).

exercises.instruction: Điền tính từ miêu tả sự chăm chú.
exercises.content: The participants are completely ________ in their dialogue.
exercises.explanation: Completely absorbed (Hoàn toàn đắm chìm).

exercises.instruction: Thiết bị bảo hộ.

options.text: Safety equipment is being utilized by the worker.
The worker forgot his protective gear.
He is manufacturing safety helmets.
He is wearing standard office clothes.

exercises.explanation: Safety equipment is being utilized (Thiết bị an toàn đang được sử dụng).

exercises.instruction: Điền từ chỉ mảnh vải/giẻ lau.
exercises.content: He is using a ________ to dry the surface.
exercises.explanation: Using a cloth (dùng mảnh vải).
